facts.text: 100,000 paying subscribers were scored this week.
About 9,076 subscribers are expected to cancel in the next 30 days (9% of the base).
Total monthly revenue at risk is PKR 2,764,263.
The high-risk group is the top 10,000 subscribers (top 10%), with PKR 1,012,831 of revenue at risk.
'Followed title just ended' (content) is a top reason for 76% of the high-risk group.
'Watching much less than last week' (viewing) is a top reason for 42% of the high-risk group.
'Negative support ticket' (support) is a top reason for 34% of the high-risk group.
'Failed renewals' (payment) is a top reason for 24% of the high-risk group.
'Low balance at renewal' (payment) is a top reason for 23% of the high-risk group.
Sports: 29,505 fans followed 'T20 International Series', which ended 3 days ago; the next release, 'National Cup', arrives in 24 days. 6,644 of these fans are high-risk.
Drama: 14,121 fans followed 'Season finale of a prime-time serial', which ended 6 days ago; the next release, 'New prime-time serial', arrives in 5 days. 986 of these fans are high-risk.
Kids: 3,025 fans followed 'Animated series season', which ended 12 days ago; the next release, 'New animated season', arrives in 18 days. 625 of these fans are high-risk.
The 'Payment-troubled' group (want to stay but billing keeps failing) has 28,466 subscribers, 5,794 of them high-risk, with PKR 1,179,439 of monthly revenue at risk.
The 'Frustrated by quality' group (buffering, crashes, slow starts or an angry ticket) has 22,223 subscribers, 2,435 of them high-risk, with PKR 662,465 of monthly revenue at risk.
The riskiest plan is Sports Premium: average churn risk 12%, PKR 824,338 at risk.
The riskiest payment channel is Operator 1: average churn risk 10%, PKR 887,853 at risk.
If the team contacts the top 10% by score, about 33% of them are real leavers, 3.61 times better than contacting people at random.
